title: The West Wing -All One Level Posh 2 Bedroom 2 Bath
description:
Location! Location! Location! Welcome to The West Wing in Nashville, TN. We offer a modern, quiet, spacious, tasteful, fully appointed, brand-new addition to our home. Private entrance, Zero steps. 2 bed, 2 full baths. Full kitchen. 8 minutes to the airport, 15 minutes to downtown Nashville. 4 minutes to The Grand Ole Opry and Opry Mills Mall. 2 minutes to the Donelson Train Station, The Greenway, Wave Pool, Skate Park and Golf Course. 1 minute to many fabulous restaurants. Everything is close!

The space
Our West Wing is designed and decorated as a modern luxury suite.
Large 1,050 sf. All one level, zero steps. Everyone loves this feature, and it can be especially ideal for seniors. 
Spacious modern living room. 
Master bedroom - King bed with full bath. 
Second bedroom - Queen bed with full bath.
Fully furnished modern kitchen.
Cable TV in all rooms.
Wireless service throughout. 
Private outdoor patio.
Free private parking space for 1 vehicle (No oversized vehicles/box trucks/moving vans, etc.). $10 per night extra parking fee to make room for a 2nd car. Two cars maximum.
Private keyless entry.
IMPORTANT - Before making a reservation request, please read our House Rules to see if we are a good fit. For instance, we require a 2 minute orientation upon arrival. Some important things and safety features must be pointed out to optimize your stay.  We want you to be 100% happy here, and the orientation assures you will be. It's fast, it's easy, and for your benefit it cannot be waived.
We also require that a prospective guest making a reservation request have a favorable Airbnb history we can review.

Guest access
Entire private addition.

Other things to note
We do not offer washer and dryer service. There are several very nearby (less than a mile) laundry mats and dry cleaners that offer same day service.
